UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user wallet balances, watch totals, streak, and daily earnings goal. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

availableCents.description: Withdrawable cash balance in USD cents.

lifetimeEarnedCents.description: Cumulative lifetime earnings in USD cents.

totalWithdrawnCents.description: Cumulative withdrawn payouts in USD cents.

totalWatchSeconds.description: Total verified advert watch duration in seconds.

dailyGoalCents.description: User daily earnings goal in USD cents.

currentStreakDays.description: Consecutive calendar days with at least one completed advert watch.

lastActiveDate.description: Last active calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format or empty string on creation.

preferredCategories.description: Ordered list of user-selected preferred advert categories used to prioritize the feed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

AdViewRecord.title: AdViewRecord
AdViewRecord.description: Immutable record of a verified advert view and cash reward earned. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

campaignId.description: Identifier of the watched advert campaign.

rewardCents.description: Cash reward earned by viewer in USD cents.

hourOfDay.description: Hour of day (0-23) when the advert completed.

DailyEarningsStat.title: DailyEarningsStat
DailyEarningsStat.description: Per-day earnings and watch analytics summary keyed by YYYY-MM-DD. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

dateKey.description: Calendar date key YYYY-MM-DD matching document ID.

earnedCents.description: Total earnings on this date in USD cents.

adsWatched.description: Number of adverts completed on this date.

watchSeconds.description: Total watch seconds on this date.

topCategory.description: Primary advert category watched on this date.

bonusCents.description: Daily goal or streak bonus cents earned on this date.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when daily stat was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when daily stat was updated.

PayoutRecord.title: PayoutRecord
PayoutRecord.description: Immutable cashout transaction request submitted by the user. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

method.description: Cashout rail selected by the user.

LinkedPaymentMethod.title: LinkedPaymentMethod
LinkedPaymentMethod.description: User-linked preferred withdrawal account metadata with bank numbers masked to last-4 digits only. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

accountHolderName.description: Legal account holder or recipient name.

maskedDestination.description: Masked destination label shown in Wallet and payout receipts.

bankName.description: Financial institution name for BANK_ACH, empty otherwise.

accountLast4.description: Last 4 digits of linked bank account for BANK_ACH, empty otherwise.

routingLast4.description: Last 4 digits of bank routing number for BANK_ACH, empty otherwise.

autoPayoutEnabled.description: Whether the user prefers this linked account pre-selected for cashouts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when method was linked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last settings update.

OwnerRevenueSummary.title: OwnerRevenueSummary
OwnerRevenueSummary.description: Singleton platform owner income summary accumulating net margin from every verified advert watch. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for updatedAt.

availableIncomeCents.description: Withdrawable net owner income balance in USD cents.

lifetimeIncomeCents.description: Total cumulative net owner income earned in USD cents.

withdrawnIncomeCents.description: Total income withdrawn by the app owner in USD cents.

grossSponsorCents.description: Total gross advertiser spend generated across all users.

totalUserRewardsCents.description: Total user cash rewards funded from sponsor spend.

totalVerifiedViews.description: Total verified advert completions across all users.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last revenue update.

OwnerRevenueEntry.title: OwnerRevenueEntry
OwnerRevenueEntry.description: Immutable per-view owner income ledger record created atomically when any user completes an advert watch.

viewerUserId.description: UID of the user who completed the advert watch.

grossSponsorCents.description: Gross sponsor revenue paid for this view.

userRewardCents.description: Viewer reward payout for this view.

ownerIncomeCents.description: Net income credited to app owner account.

preferenceMatched.description: Whether the advert matched the viewer's preferred categories.

OwnerPayoutConfig.title: OwnerPayoutConfig
OwnerPayoutConfig.description: App owner payout account configuration for withdrawing platform income.

destinationLabel.description: Owner payout destination (bank account or PayPal/Venmo handle).

autoSweepEnabled.description: Whether automated weekly sweep preference is enabled.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last config update.

amountCents.description: Withdrawn owner income amount in USD cents.

ReferralCode.title: ReferralCode
ReferralCode.description: Unique shareable invite code owned by a user (stores zero PII). Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt.

code.description: Unique uppercase alphanumeric referral code matching the document ID.

ownerUserId.description: Firebase UID of the user who owns this referral code.

ownerFirstName.description: First name of the referrer shown to invitees.

ReferralRecord.title: ReferralRecord
ReferralRecord.description: Tracks an invitee's referral relationship and 3-ad milestone bonus status, keyed by inviteeUserId. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

referralCode.description: Referral code redeemed by the invitee.

referrerUserId.description: Firebase UID of the inviting user.

referrerFirstName.description: First name of the inviting user.

inviteeUserId.description: Firebase UID of the invited user matching document ID.

inviteeFirstName.description: First name of the invited user.

adsCompleted.description: Number of ads watched by the invitee since applying the referral code.

requiredAds.description: Number of ads required to unlock the dual referral bonus (3).

bonusCents.description: Bonus cash reward in USD cents earned by each party (50).

status.description: Whether the invitee has reached the required ad watch milestone.

inviteeCredited.description: Whether the invitee has received their referral bonus.

referrerCredited.description: Whether the referrer has claimed their referral bonus.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when referral was linked.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last status update.

/users/{userId}.description: User wallet profile, balances, and daily earnings goals.

/users/{userId}/adViews/{viewId}.description: Per-user immutable ledger of completed advert views.

/users/{userId}/dailyStats/{dateKey}.description: Per-user daily earnings and watch-time analytics summaries.

/users/{userId}/payouts/{payoutId}.description: Per-user cashout withdrawal requests and settlement history.

/users/{userId}/paymentSettings/{setting.description: Per-user linked preferred payment withdrawal method.

/ownerRevenueSummary/{summaryId}.description: Singleton global platform owner income summary document.

/ownerRevenueEntries/{entryId}.description: Immutable ledger of owner income credits generated by user advert views.

/referralCodes/{code}.description: Unique shareable referral codes mapped to owner UIDs.

/referrals/{referralId}.description: Per-invitee referral tracking and dual cash bonus settlement state.
